name: Return to the Hinterlands
summary: Thadius Grimshade tells you where Sharpbeak is kept: in a cage on a high cliff, atop Jintha'Alor in the Hinterlands. Vile Priestess Hexx, high priestess of the Vilebranch trolls, has the key. You are to carry the news to Gryphon Master Talonaxe.

sections.title: Where Sharpbeak Is Held
sections.body: Having done his part, Thadius wishes you fortune and tells you what he learned. Sharpbeak sits caged on a high cliff, atop Jintha'Alor in the Hinterlands. Vile Priestess Hexx, high priestess of the Vilebranch trolls, possesses the key to that cage. Take word of this to Gryphon Master Talonaxe.

sections.title: Talonaxe's Answer
sections.body: Talonaxe asks what Thadius said. Told that the Vilebranch trolls have Sharpbeak, Talonaxe finds it unbearable and declares that a force must be organized to get the gryphon back.

faq.q: Who reveals the location of Sharpbeak?
aliases: who tells you where sharpbeak is
faq.answer: Thadius Grimshade, who performed the ritual of divination and then told you where Sharpbeak is held.
Sharpbeak is caged on a high cliff, atop Jintha'Alor in the Hinterlands.

faq.q: Who holds the key to Sharpbeak's cage?
faq.answer: Vile Priestess Hexx, high priestess of the Vilebranch trolls, holds the key.

faq.q: Where do you deliver this news?
aliases: where to turn in return to the hinterlands
faq.answer: Take it to Gryphon Master Talonaxe in the Hinterlands.

aliases: what led to return to the hinterlands
faq.answer: Thadius Grimshade had just performed the ritual of divination to find Sharpbeak.
